messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person walks forward down the street, then stops and turns their head to the right.","camera":"A third-person view from behind the character that slowly dollies in and follows the walking motion.","clothing":"A cream-colored plaid suit jacket and matching pinstriped trousers, with brown shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blonde with a reddish-brown accent at the top of the bun.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled up into a high bun with a small reddish-brown topknot or accessory on top.","identity":"A 3D-rendered person with a slim build, seen from behind, with no visible face.","scene":"A hazy, old-style city street with cobblestone pavement, brick buildings, a Union Jack flag, and a dark shadow of a crouching figure on the ground."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunny seaside terrace to a hazy cobblestone city street with brick buildings, a Union Jack, and street lamps matching the reference. The person remains seen from behind, walking forward and then turning their head, with a similar dolly-in camera. The suit now appears cream/white rather than the source's brown/orange, and the hair appears bright blonde with a reddish topknot rather than the source's darker hair.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside scene with the reference city street while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement and adapting lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's identity and facial expression were preserved, since the face is not visible
unexpected_changes: Suit color changed from brown/orange plaid to cream/white plaid
Hair color changed from darker hair to bright blonde
A dark crouching figure/shadow appears on the street in the output
